description: This file contains abstract test class definitions for testing streaming cache miss and eviction behavior in Orleans. It includes test methods, a custom stream filter class, and relevant constants and setup code.

classes.name: StreamingCacheMissTests
classes.description: An abstract test class for verifying streaming cache behavior and cache miss scenarios in Orleans.

methods.name: PreviousEventEvictedFromCacheTest
methods.description: Test that grains handle events correctly after cache eviction, ensuring delivery of both cached and newly sent events.

methods.name: PreviousEventEvictedFromCacheWithFilterTest
methods.description: Test that filtered events do not prevent cache eviction and that delivery persists for unfiltered events.

inner_classes.name: CustomStreamFilter
inner_classes.description: A custom stream filter that only delivers messages where the first byte equals 1, used for testing filtering and cache interaction.

methods.name: CustomStreamFilter.ShouldDeliver
methods.description: Determines whether a stream message should be delivered based on custom filtering logic (first byte equals 1).
